purpose: STTR partner-type classifier seed list -> NONPROFIT_INSTITUTE, OTHER_NONPROFIT labels (specs/sttr-spinout-linkage/design.md#partner-type-classification)
source: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract (EO BMF)
update_cadence: IRS publishes a refreshed EO BMF extract monthly, on the second Tuesday of the month.
not_committed_reason: The four regional extracts total ~336 MB combined. This repository does not use Git LFS (largest currently tracked file is under 1 MB), so the raw extract is not checked into git -- consistent with the existing large-bulk-input precedent in docs/research/agency-private-capital-phase1-nsf.manifest.json, where the 394 MB award_data.csv is hash-anchored via a manifest rather than committed. Reproduce by re-downloading each file below and verifying its sha256 before use; a materially different hash means the IRS has republished the extract and this row's version must be superseded, not silently accepted.

inputs.region: IRS region 1 (per EO BMF regional split; the extract does not map 1:1 to US Census regions)

schema.notes: SUBSECTION=03 identifies IRC 501(c)(3) organizations. NTEE_CD (National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities) is the field expected to carry the most classification signal for distinguishing a science/research-institute nonprofit (major group U, and parts of H) from a generic OTHER_NONPROFIT at classifier-build time; that filtering logic belongs to task 1.3, not this capture task.
